goal: Let node operators disallow unencrypted v1 P2P connections on clearnet IPv4 and IPv6
Prevents passive on-path observers such as ISPs from eavesdropping on peer messages and transactions
agreement: Strong support with no open objections after addressing partitioning and listen concerns
Concept approval for preventing passive eavesdropping on clearnet (mzumsande, dergoegge, ajtowns, sipa)
Code review approval on the current approach (mzumsande, fjahr)
Open suggestion to replace local address exemption with peer whitelisting (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it lets users enforce transport encryption on clearnet without disabling IPv4 and IPv6
Protects against passive network eavesdropping and raises tampering costs without breaking connectivity
